description: How to write a workflow with the user: every field and what it is for, the step rules, how principles and preferences carry the user's way of working, versions, consent and the guardrails (roles and slots only; no personal or client data). session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.
